name: The IceCube Upgrade — Design and Science Goals
notes: This design paper specifies seven new strings and construction in the 2022/23 season; the Upgrade was built with five strings in the 2025/26 season (see experiment:icecube-upgrade notes).
doc_type technical_proposal is the closest available enum value for a design-and-science-goals conference paper.

summary.plain: The collaboration's design write-up for the IceCube Upgrade, explaining the extra strings of new sensors and what they are meant to measure.
summary.technical: ICRC 2019 design and science-goals paper for the IceCube Upgrade: a dense photosensor infill near the bottom centre of IceCube with new calibration devices, aimed at world-leading atmospheric oscillation sensitivity and precision tau-neutrino appearance, plus recalibration of the full IceCube archive.
